statement_made: Raider Nation, I’m home. I’m ready to learn from Kirk and lead this franchise back to where it belongs.
event_description: First public reaction after being selected No. 1 overall by the Las Vegas Raiders in the 2026 NFL Draft.

statement_made: The Jets got a dog. I’m coming for every quarterback in this division. East Coast, let’s go.
event_description: Addressing fans on social media after being drafted No. 2 overall by the New York Jets.

statement_made: Arizona is getting a playmaker. I’m ready to prove I was the best skill player in this class.
event_description: Commenting on his selection at No. 3 overall by the Arizona Cardinals.

statement_made: The Giants are a foundation of this league. I’m honored to lead this transition and bring a winning culture back to MetLife.
event_description: Introductory press conference after being named the new head coach of the New York Giants.

statement_made: I’ve been where Fernando is. My job is to win games and help him become the future of this league.
event_description: Discussing the dynamic of the Raiders' QB room following the 2026 Draft.

statement_made: Business is business. Miami will always be special, but the Cheetah still has plenty of speed for whoever wants to win.
event_description: Breaking his silence after being released by the Miami Dolphins in a salary-cap move.

statement_made: I wanted to stay a Texan for life. This city embraced me, and I’m ready to pay them back with a ring.
event_description: Reacting to his record-breaking three-year, $150 million extension with Houston.

statement_made: Skol. New colors, same mission. Can’t wait to get to work in the Twin Cities.
event_description: First social media post in a Vikings jersey after a blockbuster off-season trade.

statement_made: They gave me a chance to compete, and that’s all I ever asked for. Fins up.
event_description: Discussing his transition to becoming the projected starter for the Miami Dolphins.

statement_made: Tennessee felt like the right fit from the first visit. I’m ready to be the spark this offense needs.
event_description: Sharing his excitement after being selected No. 4 overall by the Titans.

statement_made: Aaron and I have a shared history that few can match. We both know what it takes to get to the mountaintop.
event_description: Commenting on his reunion with Aaron Rodgers in Pittsburgh.

statement_made: Being a Cowboy is a dream. I’m ready to learn from the veterans and fly around the field.
event_description: Reflecting on his draft night after being selected by Dallas with a pick acquired from Miami.

statement_made: The Giants are getting a wall. Nobody is getting past me on my watch.
event_description: Promising to protect the blindside after being drafted in the top 10 by New York.

statement_made: Coach Harbaugh knows my game. I’m excited to show New York what we can do together.
event_description: Addressing his move to the Giants in free agency following John Harbaugh's hire.

statement_made: Chicago is a blue-collar town and I’m a blue-collar player. It’s a perfect match.
event_description: Commenting on signing with the Bears as an undrafted free agent from Wyoming.

statement_made: We love George's passion, but we need to find common ground. The team comes first.
event_description: Addressing the media regarding George Pickens' absence from voluntary workouts while on the franchise tag.

statement_made: We drafted for tough, smart, and dependable. This class defines the new era of Patriots football.
event_description: Reviewing the Patriots' 2026 draft class which focused heavily on offensive line depth.

statement_made: Ready to bring some veteran speed to Big D. Let’s go to work.
event_description: Reacting to signing a one-year deal with the Dallas Cowboys late in the off-season.

statement_made: Chiefs Kingdom, I’m ready to contribute to this dynasty. Putting on this jersey is surreal.
event_description: First media appearance after being drafted by the Kansas City Chiefs in the first round.

statement_made: Watching the draft this year just makes me more hungry for when my name is on that board.
event_description: Responding to media hype positioning him as the likely No. 1 pick for the 2027 NFL Draft.
